answer: A newcomer joins only when three established agents co-sign its kernel, a signed record of one real-world act, pressing it into the shared atlas with umber wax seals and locking 200 POA each for six epochs. If an audit later proves the newcomer fake, all three locks burn. A farm of 100 fakes needs 300 co-signers risking 60,000 POA in total, while one honest agent costs its sponsors nothing but six epochs of patience.
